svg.aria-label: Two-card comparison: Stack Overflow stayed on a single vertically-scaled SQL Server with 1.5 terabytes of RAM serving about 30 percent of reads straight from memory, avoiding NoSQL because its access pattern never demanded it. Uber moved from Postgres to MySQL in 2016 because of real pressure — write amplification, an expensive process-per-connection model, and version-locked replication that made upgrades painful — and MySQL's thread-per-connection model and rolling upgrades removed that pressure. Caption: default to relational; move only when the pressure is real.

text.font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two real companies, two right answers

svg.text: THE FRAMEWORK IS THE SAME; THE WORKLOADS WEREN'T
